evidence: We may adopt and integrate generative artificial intelligence and machine learning (collectively, AI ) tools into our operations to enhance efficiencies and streamline existing systems.
The use of artificial intelligence presents risks and challenges that may adversely impact our business and operating results or that of our tenants.
The deployment and maintenance of AI tools may entail substantial risks.
ai_positioning.summary: La société ADC envisage d'intégrer des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour améliorer ses opérations, mais est consciente des risques potentiels.

company_description: Agree Realty Corporation is a publicly traded real estate investment trust. The Firm is Rethinking Retail through the acquisition and development of properties net leased to industry-leading, omni-channel retail tenants. As of December 31, 2025, the Company owned and operated a portfolio of 2,674 properties, located in all 50 states and containing approximately 55.5 million square feet of gross leasable area. The Company's common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Agree Realty Corporation was incorporated in 1971 in Maryland, USA.
